title: E-GRV-0152: composite sources are not band-mixed, partial (the meson's counts moved 0.08 between filters against...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0152 in the gravity arena: composite sources are not band-mixed, partial (the meson's counts moved 0.08 between filters against 0.02, its level unconverged on radius 7), the route's kill firing on both: read with exact projectors at each beat's stage, the register meson carries S and D counts 1.91 and 0.06 and the light register pair 1.98 and 0.027, so both are band-A pairs, and on E-GRV-0147's slab a hole of the other band is pulled toward them at 0.075 and 0.050 of the like band (a bare band-A hole 0.057), where a (1, 1) source pulls both bands equally; the two gravity fields do not average on the composites the rule holds.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
